basic_info.main_problem: After making a mistake at Work recently, persistent Self-doubt and feelings of inadequacy appeared; believing oneself not competent for this Work, and treating this mistake as the definition of one's ability, causing daily Anxiety and unease when handling important documents.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of inadequacy affect my confidence at Work and cause significant distress; I hope counseling will reduce this sense of incompetence and help me recover my confidence at Work.
growth_experiences: Family of origin: Mother is a ballet Actor, Father's information missing. No major physical or mental illness or prior psychotherapy experience reported in developmental history.

core_beliefs: I am not competent/not good enough

special_situations.event: A few weeks ago, a filing error occurred in medical records work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make one mistake, it proves I am not competent for this Work
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Afterwards, at work, excessively cautious, repeatedly checks and slows down to avoid making mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This one mistake is enough to show I am not qualified

special_situations.event: Every day when handling important documents or key tasks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake again, it will bring serious consequences and further prove my ability is insufficient
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids complex or self-perceived high-risk tasks, procrastinates submission to reduce exposure to evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I might mess up again, and the consequences will be terrible

special_situations.event: When interacting with colleagues or receiving feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they notice my mistake, they will look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces contact with colleagues; keeps a low profile to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am not professional and look down on me

special_situations.event: When alone recalling that work mistake and repeatedly replaying the error scene in his mind
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only never making mistakes counts as qualified; good performance does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: constantly self-criticize, focus on negative details to force myself to improve
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I only see the mistakes, everything else is not important

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, to prove oneself competent and valuable
core_conflict.fear: Fears being belittled, humiliated, or excluded for making mistakes
defense_goal: control risk through self-criticism and excessive caution, avoid exposing inadequacy
Keeps a certain distance from others to reduce chances of being judged

object_relations.self_representation: A flawed, error-prone person who needs to be extra careful
object_relations.object_representation: A harsh judge (colleagues / superiors who discover and amplify mistakes at any time)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes conducting a 'controllable small mistake' behavioral experiment
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: interpret this as a test of ability: if I fail, it will expose my incompetence (transference as worry about authority's judgment)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: respond in an objective, step-by-step tone, repeatedly confirm the process and details, reduce emotional expression, to control uncertainty.

manifestations: Currently lacks strong social support, feels facing work pressure alone
due to Self-doubt, Tense relationships with colleagues, reduced interaction
outcomes: Decreased work efficiency, mistakes actually increase
Hesitating to seek help when support is needed

manifestations: When discussing experiments, repeatedly confirms steps to ensure 'doing it right'
Being overly cautious at work, slowing down

manifestations: treat 'not making mistakes/must be perfect' as rigid self Demands
equate one mistake with the negate of overall ability
